ladder.label: Diplomatic Tension
ladder.trigger: Sanctions, rhetoric, proxy skirmishes; HIIK Level 1 dispute; no kinetic between major-power-aligned states. Analog: US-China trade war peak 2018-19.

ladder.label: Limited Strikes
ladder.trigger: Targeted air/missile exchanges, no ground forces; UCDP minor armed conflict (≥25 KIA/yr). Analog: 2020 Soleimani strike + Iran al-Asad retaliation (de-escalated).

ladder.label: Regional Escalation
ladder.trigger: Multiple theater activation, proxy war expansion, one cross-border ground operation. Analogs: 2008 Russia-Georgia 5-day war; 2023 Sudan civil war outbreak.

ladder.label: Direct Conventional
ladder.trigger: State-vs-state ground operations OR naval blockade OR chokepoint disruption affecting global trade. UCDP war threshold (≥1,000 KIA/yr). Analogs: 1990-91 Gulf War; 2003 Iraq invasion; 1999 NATO Kosovo.

ladder.label: Great Power Signaling
ladder.trigger: Major-power red lines tied to ongoing kinetic, OR summit produces operational economic-architecture commitments, OR cyber op crosses Tallinn-Manual use-of-force. Analogs: 2022 Russia invasion early months; Stuxnet 2010; 2024 Israel-Iran direct exchanges; NotPetya 2017.

ladder.label: Nuclear Posturing
ladder.trigger: DEFCON 3 OR rival equivalent OR nuclear-armed state crosses enrichment threshold OR leadership invokes nuclear use with operational detail. Analogs: 1973 Yom Kippur DEFCON 3; 2017 'fire and fury'; Sep-Oct 2022 Russia nuclear rhetoric peak (Biden 'Armageddon').

ladder.label: Alliance Fragmentation
ladder.trigger: NATO/Gulf/equivalent allied bloc PUBLICLY BREAKING with lead power on an operational commitment — not friction. Analogs: 1966 France leaves NATO integrated command; 2003 Iraq War 'Old vs New Europe' split; 2025 Trump Article-5 ambiguity moments.

ladder.label: Major-Power Nuclear Posturing
ladder.trigger: DEFCON 2 OR equivalent — nuclear weapons loaded onto delivery systems; max readiness short of launch. Reached publicly only twice. Analogs: Cuban Missile Crisis SAC at DEFCON 2 (Oct 22 – Nov 15 1962); 1991 Gulf War SAC at DEFCON 2; Able Archer 83 Soviet warhead loading.

ladder.label: Nuclear Threshold
ladder.trigger: Nuclear briefcase activated OR first-use doctrine published OR launch-decision window entered. Analogs: Cuban Missile 'Black Saturday' Oct 27 1962 (sub B-59 nearly fired nuclear torpedo; McNamara post-1990s: 99% if invasion); 1995 Norwegian rocket (only known briefcase activation).

ladder.label: Global Thermonuclear
ladder.trigger: Multi-party nuclear exchange has begun. NEVER OCCURRED. Doomsday Clock 85 seconds (Jan 2026, closest ever) is the standing macro indicator that systemic risk is elevated but not at this rung.
